Look.note: Eyes lead; head and shoulders follow with a curious tilt.

Walk.note: Short planted strides and relaxed arm counter-swing.

Run.note: Quicker cadence, airborne swing, soft knees and forward intent.

Jump.note: Quick anticipation, symmetric arm swing, modest tuck, gravity-led flight and soft landing. No raised-fist pose.

Land.note: Feet hold while knees, torso and head absorb and settle.

Greeting.note: Curious wind-up, springy rise, three broad waves, happy face and a soft settling nod.

Emotes.note: Warm, curious, surprised, focused, happy and sleepy face states.

boundary: Motion review and flat-ground play only; no world/save/progress changes. Generic jump, not a copied signature pose.
